name: commons-grok-cloud
description: Run bounded grok.com work from GPT cloud sessions with Commons, Slack, and exact receipts.

interface.shortDescription: Give GPT cloud sessions a durable grok.com work lane.
interface.longDescription: Installs the shared Commons MCP plus the missing cloud-browser executor. It consumes the canonical grok.com orchestrator and durable wake-job packets, drives the account's existing grok.com session, and returns Slack and Commons receipts with the real conversation URL, prompt, result, and inspected SHA.
defaultPrompt: Run this task through grok.com and land the receipt.
Take the next unclaimed Grok task from Commons.
Show the live Commons model-route catalog.
